name: asm_x86_O2_arm_O2_bench
description: A benchmark comparing or evaluating assembly code across x86 and ARM architectures (compiled with -O2) intended to test models' ability to reason about, translate, or generate low-level code. Tasks probe architecture-specific semantics, register/ABI differences, and require precise, expert knowledge of assembly and compiler output.
reputation: A narrowly focused dataset with limited but useful adoption for research in binary/assembly analysis and cross-architecture code modeling.
